description:
Maternity health insurance is a specialised health policy that gives you extensive coverage for all pregnancy-related medical expenses — from hospitalisation and delivery costs (both normal and C-section), to pre & post-natal care, essential medical tests, and even newborn baby expenses.

Having maternity cover in your health insurance not only brings financial stability, but also gives expecting parents peace of mind while preparing for the biggest journey of their life — raising a baby.

In this video, we’ve compared the TOP 6 Health Insurance Plans that offer Maternity Benefits — side by side — so you can choose the one that’s right for you.

Top 6 MATERNITY Health Insurance Plans in 2026 :-

comments.text: This Reliance Health Infinity policy includes maternity cover. You must take a 3-year policy and pay the premium upfront to activate it. After the waiting period, it covers ₹2 lakh for the mother (normal/C-section + pre- and post-natal expenses) and ₹1 lakh for the newborn, which also includes newborn vaccinations. Maternity is available only in the 3-year plan and is covered within the total sum insured.
